items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:39:1
items.html: AVI were at first face to face, since Mochin were made for them from Keter: As written above (page 509, the passage beginning “The Hassadim and Gevurot”), the coupling of Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] of AVI came about through the attainment of the revealed NHY that they attained from the Keter of Nekudim, see there.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:39:2
items.html:
Their MAN, which causes them the establishment and the sustaining of the phase of face to face, was the existence of the seven kings: It has already been explained above that AVI do not turn face to face except through the raising of MAN [female waters] by ZON, as above (page 501, in the Inner Light, the passage beginning “The fourth degree,” study it there well). This is because Bina, from her root, is in the secret of “for He delights in mercy,” and she rejects Hochma. Only at the time when ZON rise to her as MAN is her root in direct light awakened in her, since the ZON of direct light are her children, whom she emanated with illumination of Hochma. Therefore, after ZON rise to her as MAN and Bina is awakened to bestow illumination of Hochma upon them, she then cuts off her posterior and turns her face to Hochma, and couples with him face to face and renews the illumination of Hochma for ZON. And after ZON attain illumination of Hochma, they then come to their place below. And from then onward Bina is found in a coupling face to face with Hochma, in order to sustain the illumination of Hochma in ZON, as above, study it there well.
And here — (A note in the author’s own handwriting: this requires examination, for ZON were emanated from the Hotem and Peh of the Dikna prior to this, and from the Vav and the point they received only the Gadlut, as above, Part 6, Inner Observation, item 19, that the lowering of the bottom Hey to the Peh, which is the secret of Vav, makes a Shuruk) — ZON had not yet been emanated such that they could rise as MAN to AVI. Therefore this raising of MAN was done by means of the NHY of the inner AK, and the Yesod of AK illuminated for AVI the secret of the Shuruk, Vav and a point, as above in the words of the ARI (page 423, item 31), where the Vav is the phase of ZA and the point is the phase of the Nukva, and these became MAN in Ima. And then Ima was awakened to bestow illumination of Hochma upon them, and she cut off her posterior and returned face to face with Aba; and AVI raise MAN still higher, that is, to Keter, and Keter too to the one above it, and so on up to Ein Sof. And then a new light descends from Ein Sof and cascades through the degrees until the drop of the coupling of AVI, which descends upon the Vav and the point within them, which are ZON, and they acquire illumination of Hochma. And after this they expanded to their place below, that is, to the seven lower ones of Nekudim. And in order to sustain the illumination of Hochma in ZON, Ima is obliged to continue the face to face with Aba.
And with this you will understand the words of the ARI, that not only do ZON cause the return of AVI to face to face while they are within Ima above in the secret of MAN, but even after they have expanded below to their place they are likewise reckoned as causing the sustaining of the coupling of AVI face to face; for on their account Ima is obliged to be face to face with Aba, in order to sustain their illumination in ZON, as explained. And this is what he says: “Their MAN, which caused them the establishment and the sustaining of the phase of face to face, was the existence of these seven kings, who were in the womb of Bina, and these were her MAN.” That is, as above, that at first the seven kings were in the phase of MAN in the womb of Bina, for they are the Vav and the point that the Yesod of AK bestowed upon them, and upon their coming into the womb of Ima they caused her to return face to face with Aba, as above. And afterwards too, when the seven kings expanded and descended to their place, they likewise cause for AVI the establishment and the sustaining of the phase of face to face, for on their account Bina is obliged to continue her coupling face to face with Aba, in order to bestow and to sustain the illumination of Hochma in them, as explained.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:39:3
items.html:
Since they broke and died, therefore AVI too, their posterior which sustained them face to face, descended below: For the entire matter of continuing the coupling face to face of AVI is only for the sake of sustaining the illumination of Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] in the children, who are ZON, as above in the adjacent item. Therefore, after the children died, Bina no longer has any need to continue the face to face with Aba, and therefore they return to back to back, and the whole phase of the lights of Gadlut that were in them descend from their degree and fall to the phase of the Guf [body] and the ZAT, meaning that they were pushed out of the Rosh [head] of AVI.
And the reason for their descent from the Rosh of AVI is that Bina returned to her original degree, which esteems the Hassadim more than the light of Hochma, as above. It follows that after the children died and she no longer has need to draw illumination of Hochma for their sake, she immediately returns to back to back, that is, to her former state, to draw Hassadim and to reject Hochma. And by this she pushed and cast the Mochin of Hochma outside the Rosh, to the phase of the ZAT, in the secret of the verse, “Are not my princes altogether kings?” (Isaiah 10:8). For these posteriors that descended from their degree and became princes were formerly kings, that is, while they were above in the Rosh of AVI in the phase of Mochin of Gadlut. And now, when they descended to the phase of the ZAT, they became princes, meaning those who are subordinate and enslaved to the kings. And understand this.
